prompt: One temperature reading says 500°C in a log of room temperatures.
why: One value far from the rest.
trap: A single point, not a tail.

prompt: A single customer ordered 10,000 units when everyone else orders 1 to 5.
tells: 10,000 units when everyone else orders 1 to 5
trap: One customer, not a long tail.

prompt: One student's age is entered as 210, which is probably a typo.
A sensor shows a single huge spike, then goes back to normal.
Before drawing a trend line, the analyst checks one point that sits far from all the others.
tells: one point that sits far from all the others
why: An outlier can bend a trend line.
trap: The trend is the goal; the point is an outlier.

prompt: A marathon results list includes one time of 45 minutes, far faster than the world record.
tells: far faster than the world record
